messages.subject: sfit compilation error
parts:
Hi Henrik,

Thanks for the great package! I keep getting this sfit package problem
while installation - showing 'compilation error'. Is there anything
that I can do? My system is OS X on new Mac pro.

I could define the raw data, but could not do further analyses. My
guess is that's because of the sfit problem?

I was going to post it in the discussion forum but google was too slow
so I am just sending you the email. Thanks in advance!
Murim

On Tue, Feb 26, 2008 at 8:59 AM, Mur...@gmail.com <mur...@gmail.com> wrote:
>
> Hi Henrik,
>
> Thanks for the great package! I keep getting this sfit package problem
> while installation - showing 'compilation error'. Is there anything
> that I can do? My system is OS X on new Mac pro.

First of all, I'm not an OSX user so I cannot test what I am saying.
What do you get if you do:

print(getOption("pkgType"));

However, try to install the pre-built binary version of 'sfit' on your
"new Mac pro" by doing:

source("http://www.braju.com/R/hbLite.R");
options(pkgType="mac.binary");
hbLite("sfit", force=TRUE);

If it seems to work, then try the following in a fresh R session:

library(sfit)
example(cfit.matrix)

If the example runs without errors 'sfit' is successfully installed.

If that does *not* work, do:

source("http://www.braju.com/R/hbLite.R");
options(pkgType="source");
hbLite("sfit", force=TRUE);

and *make sure* to report your 1) sessionInfo() and 2) all of the
output that installation script generates. Then, some OSX gurus can
hopefully help out.

>
> I could define the raw data, but could not do further analyses. My
> guess is that's because of the sfit problem?
Yes. So, if you can install it as above, everything else should be solved.

>
> I was going to post it in the discussion forum but google was too slow
> so I am just sending you the email. Thanks in advance!

Yes, there are some issues with the google group page being slow/times
out, but as soon as you manage to join the group online, the actual
mailing list works fine without delays.

Cheers

/Henrik

> Murim
> >
